definitions.rain: Gauge-sensitive research profile: independent observed liquid accumulation >=0.2 mm in one explicitly timed hour; onset interval/review required, not an IMD universal warning definition
definitions.snowstorm: Independently confirmed occurrence under a reviewed snowstorm definition; cold/humidity or snowfall amount alone is insufficient
definitions.cloudburst: Reviewed local gauge accumulation >=100 mm in an explicitly verified one-hour interval, physical event identity and onset uncertainty retained
